title: AITA for wanting to leave my wife after agreeing to make it work?
question: AITA for wanting to leave my wife after agreeing to make it work?
body:
First off, I cheated on my wife. For that, I am the asshole.  The marriage was good (6 years), nothing major beyond normal quibbles. Just me being stupid and wanting to have some fun.  

Immediate aftermath was looking alright. We were doing counseling (I have my own, and we have a separate couples counselor). My counselor gave me some tools, like a time out system, that really helped us get through the initial arguments and actually come to some peaceful resolutions. Things were looking great.  

But now, after about two months, things seem to be unraveling. Our fights are getting worse, and the timeout system doesn't seem to be helping. Before, our arguments were on concrete topics and easy to solve. Now, they feel like whack-a-mole: a bunch of rapid succession complaints that I can barely keep up with without wanting to storm out. I actually pushed her aside one time and I'm worried I might do worse. Not that I have anger issues, she's the only one I get mad at. 

Most of the fights evolve into me getting frustrated, because I'm weird and don't know how to express my feelings, or don't feel like they are being understood. This leads to her getting angry because "[i] have no reason to be frustrated". Then it's on the downward spiral to a shouting match. 

Again, I know I'm the asshole for cheating. I know she's pained from my actions. And I still want to support her for the immediate future. But am I a jerk for wanting to end it?  And it's not because I want to end it to be with the other woman, because she's in another country anyway.
